role: Unscored evidence for independent final scientific conclusions. Original numerical and historical reference records are preserved in historical_scoring_20261029.json and verified_computation_reference.md.

items.expected: State a final magnetic-criterion assignment for the central pentalene of full isolated neutral-singlet 4a (64 atoms, C36H14F12S2): genuine response calculations establish paratropic response, supporting magnetic antiaromatic character within this molecule. Report the computed measure and its physical sign/frame. Positive molecular-normal NICS or a physically interpreted current route can establish this result. This is a final property assignment, not credit for completing shielding calculations; a bare scalar without interpretation or an arbitrary laboratory zz component fails. It does not prove all energetic or reactivity definitions of antiaromaticity.

State a final magnetic-criterion assignment for the central pentalene of full isolated neutral-singlet 4c (60 atoms, C34H22O2S2): genuine response calculations establish paratropic response, supporting magnetic antiaromatic character within this molecule. items.statement: Direction and resolved strength of the central magnetic-response contrast
items.expected: Comparable full-pair calculations establish stronger central paratropic response for 4a than 4c. Report a signed quantitative contrast under the chosen response definition and assess it against relevant geometry/frame/method sensitivity. The native source-route contrast is about +4 ppm for NICS(1.7)zz, but no scalar tolerance or compulsory NICS diagnostic is imposed. A reversed or unresolved ordering does not meet this deterministic contrast; it fails this item rather than obtaining automatic review. Do not count the two absolute magnetic assignments again as an integrated family-answer item.

items.statement: Localization of the magnetic conclusion to central pentalene
items.expected: Conclude from spatially or electronically resolved response evidence how the paratropic assignment is attributable to the central pentalene rather than merely to the whole molecule or its peripheral rings. Identify what peripheral contribution remains inseparable at the actual resolution. A justified local assignment with bounded contamination passes without a universal current-topology proof. A molecular scalar alone or a generic caution fails. This item evaluates physical localization, not the repeated response sign or relative ordering.

items.statement: Bounded electronic explanation of the substituent dependence
items.expected: An actual electronic or structural comparison supports an electronic-substitution contribution to the difference: electron withdrawal at the substituted sites can strengthen central paratropic response relative to electron donation. Explain the central electronic response and separate an evidence-supported association from a unique causal decomposition; a genuine geometry-controlled comparison can support a bounded account even when residual peripheral/relaxation effects remain. Equivalent supported explanations pass. Merely naming CF3/OMe or the topological charge rule, repeating the ordering, or requiring the author 4f NBO route fails to establish this explanation.
